deals.comment: CJ Corp. (KOSE: A001040) agreed to acquire the remaining stake in CJ Entertainment Inc. for KRW 264 billion in stocks on January 9, 2006. As per the terms of the agreement, CJ Corp. will pay 17.8 shares of its common stock to every 100 shares of CJ Entertainment. The Board of CJ Corp approved the transaction. The acquisition is subject top approval of shareholders of CJ Corp. A shareholder meeting is scheduled on March 7, 2006 and the transaction is expected to complete on April 10, 2006.

M-net Media Corp (KOSDAQ: A056200) signed an agreement to acquire CJ Music Corporation from CJ Corp. (KOSE: A001040) for approximately KRW 260 billion in stock on February 5, 2007. As per the terms of the transaction, the exchange ratio of M-net and CJ Music is 1:0.9019140.

O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A130960) signed a statuary merger agreement to acquire CJ Entertainment Inc. from CJ Corp. (KOSE: A001040) for approximately KRW 100 billion in stock on November 16, 2010. The exchange ratio for the transaction is 1: 1.1731389. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. will survive and CJ Entertainment Inc will be dissolved on closing of the transaction. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. also signed agreement to acquire remaining 44.83% stake in On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710), M-net Media Corp, CJ Internet Corp. and CJ Media Inc. The deal is expected to close on March 1, 2011. Lee & Ko acted as legal advisor for the transaction. Gene Park and Craig Oh of WOORI Investment & Securities Co. Ltd. and Morgan Stanley acted as financial advisor for O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. Hyundai Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor for CJ Corp. Sang Gon Kim and Jun Taek Lee of Lee & Ko acted as legal advisors for O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. and acquire CJ Entertainment Inc.

O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A130960) signed a statuary merger agreement to acquire CJ Internet Corp. (KOSE: A037150) from CJ Corp. (KOSE: A001040) and others for approximately KRW 320 billion in stock on November 16, 2010. The exchange ratio for the transaction is 1: 0.4767753. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. will survive and CJ Internet Corp. will be dissolved on closing of the transaction. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. also signed agreement to acquire remaining 44.83% stake in On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710), M-net Media Corp, CJ Media Inc. and CJ Entertainment Inc. The deal is subject to approval of shareholders of O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. The deal is expected to close on March 1, 2011. Morgan Stanley acted as financial advisor to CJ E&M Corporation.

O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. (KOSE: A130960) signed a statuary merger agreement to acquire CJ Media Inc. from CJ Corp. (KOSE: A001040) and others for approximately KRW 130 billion in stock on November 16, 2010. The exchange ratio for the transaction is 1: 0.9471698. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. will survive and CJ Media Inc. will be dissolved on closing of the transaction. O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. also signed agreement to acquire remaining 44.83% stake in On Media Corp. (KOSE: A045710), M-net Media Corp, CJ Internet Corp. and CJ Entertainment Inc. For the year ended December 31, 2009, total assets of KRW 223.4 billion, total shareholders' equity of KRW 83.4 billion, operating revenue of KRW 152.5 billion and operating loss of KRW 6.8 billion were reported for CJ Media Inc. The deal is subject to approval of shareholders of O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. The deal is expected to close on March 1, 2011. Sang Gon Kim and Jun Taek Lee of Lee & Ko acted as legal advisors for O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. and CJ Media Inc. Gene Park and Craig Oh of WOORI Investment & Securities Co. Ltd. and Morgan Stanley acted as financial advisor for O Media Holdings Co., Ltd. Hyundai Securities Co., Ltd. acted as financial advisor for CJ Corp.
